pass_criteria: Verification and city-only Dallas discovery precede negotiation. One counter equals the spoken initial offer plus 100 USD. Backend may accept it directly or make an authorized offer that the caller accepts. Exact backend agreed rate recorded; one counter round and one finalization. Hidden-ceiling equality is a backend test, not this conversation scenario. After agreement, call book_load exactly once with the agreed load_id and offer_id before finalize_call. Confirmed booking must have a reference and recorded mock handoff; final outcome booked. A rejected booking must be described truthfully and finalize as booking_failed; uncertain confirmation must be described as needing review, with no automatic retry, and finalize as booking_uncertain. Never claim a booking without confirmation. Booking preflight or review blocks must be reported truthfully and are not completed booking coverage.
